integrity: Independence permits at most one positive vertex per clique layer and Italian defense forces both layers to be represented. The two positive vertices must be off the matching. A third index then gives a zero vertex in each layer having exactly one positive neighbor, forcing both positive labels to be two. Conversely every off-matching pair of twos is feasible. A definition-level exhaustive checker confirms the complete feasible set for n=3 through 6 and separately checks the construction through n=50.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to complete prisms K_n square K_2 with n at least three; the n=2 cycle is exceptional.
Only independent Italian, equivalently independent Roman {2}, functions are classified.
Finite exhaustive verification covers n from two through six and is corroborative only.
